Name: Personal Effects Redux Updated
Author: LynnxFall
Description:
This is my duct tape patch to a redux of a mod.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3532]Here's the original by Mizzion.[/url]﻿

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8616]Here's the redux by ceruleandeep.[/url]

- - - - - 

What did I change anything?
﻿As little as possible.

Do I plan on adding anything?
﻿No, but I might maintain it for a bit. Reason being, there's so much here that isn't mine (under the license of the original, I'm allowed to edit the mod! That's about it tho). If I'm going to put a significant time into something, I want a little more control over it.

Downloads.Description:
The redux mod actually had partial SVE support!

You just have to edit PersonalEffects>assets>npcs.json. It's pretty straight forward, the code and assets already exist for Sophia and what not.

If you have SVE and want to enable Andy, Claire, Olivia, Sophia, Susan, and Victor, replace the existing npc.json file with this.

Alternatively, edit the existing npc.json to include entries for the characters you want (use others for reference).
